groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: anything wet.

chars.story: Hard going where the water ends: a strip of sand and shallows.
chars.note: Also 'shoal' or 'rapids'.

chars.story: Water, and then 'not any': desert.
chars.note: 冷漠 'indifferent' is the other common use.

chars.story: Wet paint spread across a wall: daub.
chars.note: Also a surname.

chars.story: Swirl water through the pan to wash out the mud and keep the good.
Water poured on the sprouts to feed them: nourish.
A case that holds water: it includes what is inside.
chars.note: Rarely alone; 函 is in this stage too.

chars.story: Where the water meets the bank.
chars.note: Mostly a place-name character: 浦东 is the Pudong district of Shanghai.

chars.story: A touch of ice in the air: cool.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 艹 straw + 冫 ice
chars.story: Under a roof stuffed with straw, ice on the floor: bitter cold.
Liquid turning to ice, stiff and unsure of itself: congeal.

groups.title: hand 扌: moving things
groups.note: A hand does something to a thing.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 隹 bird + 乃 (sound)
chars.story: A hand holding a bird and taking it along.
A hand inspecting a surface with a cloth: wipe.
Hands pushing everyone into one tight row: squeeze.
A hand flicks something out of the way.
chars.note: Also 'to dial' a phone, 'to allocate' money.

chars.story: A hand wrings it into an ugly shape: twist.

groups.title: hand 扌: holding down
groups.note: Hands that grip, press or break.

chars.story: A hand clamps down on a man in armour: held in custody.
A hand grips so the thing cannot move: restrain.
A hand pressing down on a kneeling figure: hold down.
chars.note: Also 'or': 抑或.

chars.story: A hand pulls down a whole mountain: ravage.
Hands fighting to get free: struggle.
chars.note: Also 'to earn': 挣钱.

chars.story: The person who gets a cause flourishing: the one who initiates.
A person who looks down on everyone: arrogant.
A person swinging a dagger-axe: fell, attack.
A person down low like a dog: bent over, lying hidden.
chars.note: Mostly meets it as 'lie hidden'.

chars.story: The heart feels a loss: regret.

chars.parts: 夗 curled up (sound) + 心 heart
chars.story: A heart curled up around a grudge: resentment.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'resentment'. Modern 抱怨 is 'complain'.

chars.story: A monkey's heart, all fooling about: stupid.
chars.note: The written 'stupid': 愚蠢, 愚昧; modestly, 'I'.

chars.story: A heart left hanging, not settled: suspended.
chars.note: Traditional 懸.

chars.story: A heart that stays the same all the way through: constant.
chars.note: Traditional 恆.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: A woman on the left or below.

chars.story: How a woman holds herself: her posture.
chars.note: Mostly seen in 姿势 'posture'.

chars.story: A woman who goes to a new home: she is married off.
chars.note: Used for the woman: she marries into a household.

chars.story: A hand steadies a woman in place: all is in order, settled.
A bewitching woman-like spirit: demon.
A woman holding her little treasure: infant.
chars.note: Traditional 嬰 has two shells; simplified keeps one.

chars.story: A foot coming down hard on the ground: tread.
Feet stamping down as if scooping at the ground: trample.
chars.note: Almost only in 舞蹈 'dance'.

chars.story: Claws gripping the ground to move up: crawl, climb.
chars.note: Also 'climb': 爬山.

chars.story: A troop sent walking off on a mission: dispatch.

chars.parts: 辶 walk + 屰 upside-down man
chars.story: Walking toward someone who is coming the other way: go against.
Small steps, one after another: slowly.
chars.note: Also a surname.

chars.story: Put inside the earth: bury.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 死 dead + 廾 two hands
chars.story: Two hands lay the dead in the grass: burial.
A big mound of earth: a tomb.
A hole dug in the earth: pit.

chars.parts: 肉 meat + 又 hand + 示 altar
chars.story: A hand lays meat on the altar: offer rites.
At the altar, asking: pray.

chars.parts: - two bamboo stalks with leaves hanging down
chars.story: Two stalks and their hanging leaves: bamboo.

chars.parts: 叒 three hands + 木 tree
chars.story: Hands stripping leaves from a tree for the silkworms: mulberry.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 彡 feathery strokes
chars.story: A tree with feathery needles: fir.
A tree with pale wood: cypress.
chars.note: Also a surname, and in 柏林 'Berlin'.

chars.story: Wooden pieces moved on a board: chess.
chars.note: Covers board games in general.

chars.story: The main piece of wood that holds the roof: pillar.

groups.title: metal 钅
groups.note: The metal radical on the left.

chars.story: Metal coins changing hands at the counter: a small shop.
chars.note: Also a verb, 'spread out, lay': 铺路.

chars.story: The metal every old coin looked the same in: copper.
The easy metal that melts at a touch: tin.
chars.note: 无锡 Wuxi is a city.

chars.story: A thread stretching so far that faces fade: distant.
chars.note: Meets it mainly in 缅怀 and in the country name 缅甸 'Myanmar'.

chars.story: The head rope of a net, pulling every strand: the guiding principle.

chars.parts: 贝 shell + 反 turn over
chars.story: Money flipped back and forth: buy and sell, peddle.
A man with weapons who takes the valuables: thief.
chars.note: Traditional 賊.

chars.story: Fire piled on fire: red, swollen inflammation.
chars.note: The flame itself is the older sense.

chars.parts: 日 sun + 日 sun + 日 sun
chars.story: Three suns glittering: crystal.

chars.parts: 土 earth over a 小-like flame shape
chars.story: Earth glowing over a fire: scarlet, bare.
chars.note: Also 'bare': 赤脚 'barefoot'. Originally 大 over 火.

chars.story: Silk dyed in a royal shade: purple.
An eye burning with attention: take a look.
chars.note: Colloquial.

chars.story: An eye scanning from a high place.
chars.note: Almost only in 瞭望.

groups.title: mouth and words
groups.note: A mouth open, a word spoken.

chars.story: A mouth hanging open, standing still like a tree: blank.

chars.parts: 口 mouth + 圭 jade tablet (sound)
chars.story: A mouth wide open: wow.
chars.note: An interjection, as in 好哇.

chars.story: Everyone's words in agreement: harmonious.
Big words from someone who lacks: a boast.
chars.note: Both 'boast' and 'praise'.

chars.story: Mountains squeezing in on a river: gorge.
A town ruled by a lord: an old county.
chars.note: An old unit, the commandery; in modern prose mostly in historical titles.

chars.story: Fields wrapped around the town: the suburbs.
chars.note: 缅甸 is the country name; 沉甸甸 means 'heavy'.

chars.story: A roof over your head: your dwelling.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 木 wood, with a crossed frame between
chars.story: A roof and a fence of timber: a stockade.
The roof over everything, time with no end.
chars.note: Only seen in 宇宙.

chars.story: An animal that never gives way: fierce and cruel.

chars.parts: - a gnawing rodent: teeth on top, belly, tail
chars.story: Teeth at the top, a belly, a tail curling at the bottom: rat.

chars.parts: 几 + 又, a bird reduced to two shapes
chars.story: A great bird with a swept tail: phoenix.
chars.note: Traditional 鳳 shows the bird 鸟 inside.

groups.title: food and growing
groups.note: The kitchen and what grows damp.

chars.parts: 厂 cliff + 豆 bean + 寸 inch
chars.story: Beans and careful measuring under a shelter: the kitchen.
Rice boiled into goo: paste.

chars.parts: 酉 wine jar + 卒 soldier
chars.story: A soldier at the wine jar until it is finished: drunk.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 囗 box + 禾 grain
chars.story: Grain boxed up damp, and something grows on it: fungus.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 耤 field-work (plough + past)
chars.story: Grass laid under you to soften the seat: a cushion.
chars.note: Often a stand-in for 借 in 藉口.

chars.story: Clothes stripped off, bare as a fruit: naked.

chars.parts: - 衣 clothes with a stroke through the middle
chars.story: A coat worn through in the middle: things decline.

groups.title: bad turns
groups.note: A fall in standing or luck.

chars.story: Little strength: inferior.
An ear that cannot bear to hear it: shame.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'shame'. Traditional 恥 had 心 heart in place of 止.

chars.story: Even at the great altar nothing helps: helpless.
chars.note: Almost only in 无奈 'helpless'.

chars.story: A net hung out dry: rarely any catch.

chars.parts: - an axe head on a handle
chars.story: An axe, and the weight of an axe-head: half a kilo.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'axe'. Modern 斤 is mainly the 500 g unit.

chars.story: A knife that goes forward through cloth in two blades: scissors.

chars.parts: 丯 notches + 刀 knife + 大 person
chars.story: A man cuts notches in a tally with a knife: contract.

chars.parts: - a three-legged ritual wine cup, a hand 寸 below
chars.story: The ritual wine cup that marked a lord's rank.
chars.note: 爵士 is 'jazz' or 'knight'.

chars.parts: 雨 rain + 革 leather + 月 moon
chars.story: A storm of rain over the stretched hide under the moon: a tyrant.

chars.parts: 彳 step + 山 mountain + 幺 thread + 攵 tap
chars.story: A thread sewn on the cloth by a tapping hand: a badge.
Flesh you can flex: muscle.
chars.note: 月 here is flesh, not moon.

chars.parts: - a case with a flap and a seal
chars.story: A letter case with its flap sealed.
chars.note: Also 'function' in maths.

chars.story: A jade you can see right through: glass.
chars.note: Only seen in 玻璃 'glass'.

chars.parts: 舁 four hands + 车 cart
chars.story: Four hands lift the cart body: a carriage.
chars.note: Modern use is almost only 舆论 'public opinion'.

chars.parts: 申 stretch + a flowing stroke on the right
chars.story: Stretched out with nothing in the way: smooth.

sentences.en: You should get your hair cut.
There are rats in the kitchen.
The boy was naked to the waist.
I struggled to get out of the subway.
She has buried her only son.

sentences.zh: 缅甸反华情绪正在增长。
sentences.en: Anti-Chinese sentiment is on the rise in Myanmar.

sentences.zh: 我不会嫁给一个愚蠢的男人。
sentences.en: I don't want to marry a stupid man!

sentences.zh: 炎炎夏日，空调全天开放让我们保持凉爽。
sentences.en: On a hot summer day, the air conditioner works all day to keep us cool.
